profile.headline: Software Engineer | React, TypeScript | Leader in DX & Technical Strategy
profile.summary:
With over seven years of experience in software engineering, I specialize in building web applications using React and TypeScript. As a Staff Software Engineer at Bushel, I’ve led cross-functional teams to deliver impactful solutions across eCommerce, CMS, CRM, and finance.

Beyond coding, I am deeply passionate about developer experience (DX), streamlining workflows through automation, documentation, and well-structured processes. 

My approach to software engineering balances technical leadership with hands-on development. I enjoy making strategic tech stack decisions, mentoring engineers, and ensuring architectures align with business objectives. Whether it’s optimizing site reliability or spearheading UI component libraries, I thrive in environments that encourage innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

I am always excited by emerging technologies and continuously expanding my expertise. I actively engage with React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#, C++, and more. I’m eager to connect with like-minded professionals passionate about software engineering, DX, and building impactful products!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fargo, North Dakota, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Led the development of shared frontend libraries, improving UI consistency and accelerating cross-team productivity.
- Spearheaded the creation of a micro frontend to integrate a payment platform into a farm management system
- Participated in technical architecture decisions, ensuring alignment between business goals and engineering strategy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fargo, North Dakota, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Established a standardized pull request process, reducing code review time by up to 50%.
- Developed two micro frontends, enabling sales to seven new customers, increasing user engagement and revenue.
- Enhanced the development of a web-based mobile application using Next.js and Capacitor, accelerating deployment speed by up to 200% and reducing app size by 16%.
- Created a frontend component library with Chakra UI, standardizing UI elements and improving developer collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
-Led a team to develop a white-labeled SaaS platform for grain marketing, including subscription management and comprehensive content delivery via email and mobile applications.
- Delivered an eCommerce platform that streamlined farm equipment management and customer communication with marketing tools and real-time chat.

positions.title: Merchandiser
positions.description: In my role as a Merchandiser at PepsiCo, I was responsible for placing new products on shelves, rotating old stock, and ensuring cleanliness. Additionally, I served as a driver, delivering new products to stores efficiently. Through collaboration with my team, we optimized merchandising strategies to drive sales growth.

projects.title: Coffee Tab
projects.description:
A Chrome new tab replacement extension to br used as a start to your day. It features a to-do list, calendar, and social media feed (Facebook only at present).

The goal was to have a hub to keep you up to date during coffee breaks or your morning coffee.

projects.title: NLS Engine
projects.description: This engine represents the Next Logical Step in engine design, utilizing the component-based entity system design pattern and modular core loading. The use of components, allowing easy creation of new components that can be integrated into an existing entity, and allowing dynamic core module loading, so new cores can be integrated at run-time, the engine can be expanded with minimal code.
